title: Neemba Tracker
tagline: Internal dashboard for tracking IT assets, audits and spending.
description: I’m developing Neemba Tracker to manage IT assets, assignments, approvals and audits. It integrates Azure AD, role-based access, PDF/CSV exports and a Node.js API for machine check-ins.
features: KPI dashboard with recent activity, status indicators and a financial view of the fleet.
Full inventory management with asset records, filters, pagination, CSV import/export and safe deletion.
Assignment, return and manager/IT/allocation approval workflows for equipment requests.
User management with statuses, roles, password/PIN reset and RBAC controls.
Finance module with budgets, an expense log, document preview and automatic extraction of PDF/image invoices.
Physical audit and machine data collection through QR codes and check-ins, with a receiving API, duplicate protection and batch import.
Operational reporting and PDF/CSV exports for inventory and user data.
Responsive MD3 interface checked by multi-device, accessibility and visual regression audits.
challenges: I’m organising the modules to keep the application clear and its access rules consistent. Invoice imports and machine check-ins also require validation and duplicate checks.
learnings: This project is teaching me to design business workflows, manage permissions and maintain a consistent interface across desktop and mobile.
